reason: The frozen capital-topup control has custody +100, rights 0, a real shaped incoming event of100. Published v1 calls100 an entitlement reduction, although endpoint rights do not decrease. A parity difference alone does not establish a failed obligation. This is a same-author synthetic semantic counterexample, not a fresh transaction.
inputFormat: Keep token-recording-v1 immutable inputs and the original five-case reference/registration.
outputFormat: New explicit token-review-v2; native report/core/gate unchanged.

descriptiveFields.parity_difference: held_delta - rights_delta (signed). A change in vault surplus; not automatically lost user rights.
descriptiveFields.transfer_out: Successful ft_transfer events crossing from vault to a different account; exclude mint/burn/self transfers from payout quantity.
descriptiveFields.rights_debit_without_transfer: max(0, -rights_delta - transfer_out), only when evidence agrees. A measured debit unmatched by transfers, not an authorization/causation verdict; writeoffs/burns may need a different reference.
descriptiveFields.backing_shortfall: Largest max(0, liabilities - held) at the two observed endpoints; not an estimate of new loss. Keep unknown when required evidence/identity/scope is missing.
descriptiveFields.ledger_relation: matched/different/unknown for net custody versus rights change.
descriptiveFields.gross_in_out: Boundary-crossing custody events; self transfers do not count as delivery. Preserve mint/burn as explicitly different kinds.

meaning: Descriptive conditional reconciliation, not generic token authorization or a business-failure verdict. UI must not call surplus movement lost entitlement or claim unfunded rights when pre-existing surplus can cover them.

operationReferences.historicalFailedWithdrawal: For the selected owner-withdrawal, source-informed reference requires rights preserved when no transfer settles and transaction fails. Own raw RPC captures prove the stored rights drop; report this explicit reference failed, independently of generic parity.
operationReferences.recordedAgentPayout: For selected execute, expected delivery equals prior reserved100; compare successful token transfer to owner and rights reduction100. Raw state/signed tx identity corroboration is provider-trusted, not consensus authentication. Same-author reference, not blind grading.

sourceWorkflow: Ship portable offline verifier plus exact requests/responses and initial/corrected reader tests. For the two exact recording hashes only, offer Replay source check in local and browser UI. Stage all files against catalog hashes; bind result to selected recording hash and verifier hash. Edited imports never inherit source-check claims. Replay sends no chain query, transaction or model request.
controls: matched payout plus separate top-up does not invent unpaid rights
assigning surplus to rights does not invent new unfunded money
spending unowed surplus does not invent new rights
mint/burn are custody changes, not transfers
genuine reserved agent payout still passes
missing/faulty sources stay inconclusive or source-check unavailable
modified import cannot inherit a corroboration badge
history: Retain frozen published v1 reviewer and original reference. Explain v2 schema/semantic change; do not translate a reference change into a claimed accuracy gain. Preserve initial RPC reader11/16 and corrected16/16 results/source. No external blind audit or fresh contract/model execution.
constraints: No new agents/chats, paid API/model, wallet, signing, transaction, mainnet or messages. No copy/execute of competitor implementation. Only our own reader executes. Research source/ABI inspection is static. Goal remains active.
